description: This file defines a class ReminderTestGrain implementing grain logic related to reminders. It includes methods for checking existence, adding, removing, and receiving reminders, indicating it is part of a larger Orleans-based distributed system.

classes.name: ReminderTestGrain
classes.description: A grain class that manages reminder functionalities such as adding, removing, and checking reminders within Orleans framework.

methods.name: IsReminderExists
methods.description: Checks if a reminder with the given name exists.

methods.name: AddReminder
methods.description: Registers or updates a reminder with default 1-day time span.

methods.name: RemoveReminder
methods.description: Removes the specified reminder if it exists.

methods.name: ReceiveReminder
methods.description: Method for receiving reminder notifications; currently not supported and throws exception.
